name: com.botsrated/botsrated
title: BotsRated
description: Signed checks of x402 sellers and remote MCP servers, before your agent pays.

tools.name: start_upgrade
tools.description: Use when the free daily checks are used up and a person wants a link to buy a prepaid credit pack or to start the Live plan. Free; never charges. Returns a personal card checkout link ($10/1,000 or $25/2,500 credits, 12-mo expiry) for your API key, and the Live plan: $29/month by card or 29 USDC per 30 days (x402, no auto-renewal). No key yet: a free email-verified key (POST /v1/keys/free) gives 25 checks a day instead of 5. Plans: https://botsrated.com/pricing.

tools.name: preflight
tools.description: Use when you have a host, or you just pasted an MCP config, and you want the latest check before anything else. Free (not charged; 1000/IP/day, 25000/key/day). Latest unpaid check for an x402 or MCP host: valid 402, price, payTo, MCP tools hash, receipt link.

url.description: Seller hostname or URL, for example api.agentweather.io

tools.name: check_mcp_setup
tools.description: Use when you want to check the MCP servers in your config or a list of hosts. Free. Up to 50 hosts or mcp.json: handshake state, tool count, tools-hash change date, receipt link.

hosts.description: Hostnames, a list, or one host per line

mcp_json.description: mcp.json object. Only each server's url, serverUrl or httpUrl hostname is read.

config.description: mcp.json object or text, same as mcp_json

tools.name: watch_free
tools.description: Use when you want an email only when a covered host's measured facts change. Free. Email when one host's measured facts change (<=1/UTC day, 30 days, max 3/client). Returns handle.

host.description: Seller hostname or URL, for example api.agentweather.io

email.description: Real inbox email string for confirmation link and alerts, e.g. alerts@yourdomain.com

tools.name: what_changed
tools.description: Use when you have a handle from watch_free and you want what changed on that free watch. Free (pass handle from watch_free). Measured changes on a watch_free host (price, payTo, valid 402, listing, tools hash) with receipt links.

handle.description: Free watch handle string (brs_...) from watch_free. Same value as token.

token.description: Same value as handle (brs_...). Used only when handle is omitted.

since.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC time, e.g. 2026-11-25T00:00:00Z. Omit to use watch start.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Use when you need covered sellers or MCP servers for a task and you have not picked a host yet. Free (uses 1 of 5 free checks/IP/day or 25/key/day). Top covered x402/MCP hosts for a task with URLs.

q.description: What you need, 1-4 keywords, e.g. weather or crypto price

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: Use when you want to know how many sellers and MCP servers are covered. Free. Covered x402 sellers and remote MCP servers, sources, and last probe run times.

tools.name: sample
tools.description: Use when you want to see a real paid answer before you pay. Free. Sample paid answer (check, report, or best) for a fixed example.

route.description: Which paid answer to sample. Defaults to check when omitted.

tools.name: history
tools.description: Use when you want signed daily totals for one host. Free. Signed daily totals for one host, newest first (payees as keyed hashes).

host.description: Hostname of a covered seller or MCP server, e.g. api.agentweather.io

days.description: Number of newest UTC days to return, default 30, max 90

as_of.description: UTC calendar day YYYY-MM-DD; returns what we recorded that day, or no check recorded

tools.name: check
tools.description: Use when you want the measured facts for one host. Paid $0.01 USDC on Base (x402) after 5 free/IP/day (25/key/day). Host facts, price/payTo checks, receipts; charged only on answer.

host.description: Seller hostname or URL, for example api.agentweather.io

tools.name: report
tools.description: Use when you want the measurement history for one host (up to 1,000 probes). Paid $0.01 USDC on Base (x402) from the first call over MCP; the free reports (at least 3/day, until the overall daily free limit of 15,000 is reached) are on HTTP GET /v1/report/{host} only. Full receipt history; charged only on answer.

host.description: Seller hostname or URL, for example api.agentweather.io

tools.name: best
tools.description: Use when you want a short list of covered providers for a task. Paid $0.01 USDC on Base (x402). Three covered providers for a task, sorted by the field you pick (valid-answer rate, price or latency). Sorted measurements, not a recommendation. Charged only on answer.

task.description: What you need, 1-4 descriptive keywords, e.g. web search (not generic words like api/data/x402)

max_price.description: Optional max quoted price per call in USD, e.g. 0.01

type.description: Filter: "all" (default), "x402" sellers only, or "mcp" servers only

tools.name: seller_self_check
tools.description: Use when you want the stored measurements for a host. Free. Stored measurements for a host; verified owner can pass probe:true with session for one check.

host.description: Seller hostname or URL, for example api.agentweather.io

probe.description: Verified owners only. Runs one unpaid probe.

session.description: Owner session token. Required when probe is true.

tools.name: seller_announce
tools.description: Use when you are the verified owner and you are posting a planned price or payTo. Free (owner session + signature required). Verified owner posts a planned price and/or payTo with effective_at, sig_b64, session.

host.description: Seller hostname or URL, for example api.agentweather.io

planned_price_usd.description: Planned USD price >= 0, e.g. 0.02 (planned_price_usd or payto required)

note.description: Optional short plain-text note (up to 500 chars)

sig_b64.description: Base64 Ed25519 or P-256 signature over canonical statement
